svg.aria-label: Two stages. Stage 1: C4 + E4. Stage 2: C4 + F4. The lower voice holds C4. The upper voice goes from E4 to F4. No interval or movement names are given.
svg.title: Two paths through time

g.text: Along a line: one voice over time. Up a stage: the two notes at one moment.
How to read this graphic: Read each line from left to right: that is a voice's path.
Then look straight up at one stage: the vertical gap there is the two notes at that
moment. The picture gives only note names and stages. It does not name the pair or the
movement; the lesson does that next.
